briefings.title: Taking on ServiceNow: Coding Agents for the Rest of Us with Serval Co-Founder and CEO Jake Stauch
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Serval is a 2.5-year-old enterprise AI platform providing coding agents and guardrails for IT departments to automate internal workflows, directly challenging legacy service management systems like ServiceNow.

briefings.title: Democratizing Security for the Agentic Web with Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: As the agentic web drives an exponential surge in AI-powered security vulnerabilities and shifts the attacker landscape toward automated high school actors, Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht predicts that engineering teams will spend the next 18 months heavily prioritizing security and zero-trust infrastructure to patch 70 years of legacy software.

briefings.title: The New Apex Predator: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz on Adversaries Armed With AI Agents
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Adversaries are now deploying AI agents to execute faster, highly sophisticated attacks measured in seconds, forcing defenders to adopt frontier-style AI models and digital twins to secure the enterprise.

briefings.title: The Changing Physics of Cybersecurity and Drug Development with OpenAI President Greg Brockman
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: OpenAI President and co-founder Greg Brockman discusses the rollout of GPT-6 to over a billion people, the resolution of nearly 400 century-old math problems by AI agents, and how proactive AI tools like "Dots" are transforming productivity and the future of work.

briefings.title: Beam: The Great American Open Model with ReflectionAI Co-Founder and CEO Misha Laskin
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: ReflectionAI CEO Misha Laskin discusses the launch of Beam—a 500 billion parameter (23B active) open-weight reasoning model—explaining how the company scaled end-to-end pre-training and reinforcement learning to build a Western frontier open model that achieves 3x–4x greater reasoning efficiency than peers.

briefings.title: Frontier Chips for Frontier AI Labs, with Walter Goodwin, Founder/CEO of Fractile
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Fractile, a full-stack AI chip company founded in 2002 [sic: 2022], is building high-speed inference chips to accelerate multi-trillion parameter models for frontier AI applications, aiming to bridge the gap between chip design cycles and rapid workload evolution.

briefings.title: Re-Founding Incumbents for the AI Era with Sequence Holdings Co-Founder and CEO Michael Lee
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Sequence Holdings Co-Founder and CEO Michael Lee joins Sarah Guo to discuss Sequence's $7.7 billion take-private transaction of Baldwin with the Dell Family Office, and explains why permanent holding company structures and frontier engineering can transform market incumbents from the inside out.

briefings.title: Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference with Inception Co-Founder and CEO Stefano Ermon
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Inception co-founder and CEO Stefano Ermon discusses how his company is applying parallel diffusion architecture to discrete text and code generation as a faster, hardware-efficient alternative to autoregressive LLMs.

briefings.title: Redefining Chip Architecture with Arm CEO Rene Haas
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Arm CEO Rene Haas discusses how Arm is positioned at the epicenter of AI-driven compute demands, transitioning from an IP licensing model to physical chip production (such as the Arm AGI CPU for Meta) while navigating supply chain constraints, semiconductor manufacturing independence, and the future of robotics and edge AI.

briefings.title: She Knows the 250 People Building AI. Here's What They Actually Believe.
briefings.tldr: The AI landscape is fiercely competitive and moving at breakneck speed, driven by roughly 250 frontier researchers and high-agency founders.

briefings.title: From Restoring Sight to Reimagining the Brain, with Max Hodak
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Max Hodak, co-founder and CEO of Science Corporation, discusses the company's mission to treat the brain as a computational system—highlighting the commercial approval of their PRIMA retinal implant in Europe and their long-term vision of achieving substrate independence.

briefings.title: How Nuclear Will Unlock Energy Abundance with Valar Atomics Founder Isaiah Taylor
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Valar Atomics successfully powered an NVIDIA Blackwell chip directly with a live nuclear reactor to run the world's first nuclear-powered website at their Utah facility.

briefings.title: How Chess.com Became the World’s Biggest Chess Community with CEO Erik Allebest
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Erik Allebest and Sarah Guo discuss how Chess.com scaled to 250 million registered members, 10 million daily active users, and over $200 million in annual revenue by prioritizing pure user experience, community, and the cultural revival of chess.

briefings.title: Build 2026 Podcast: Satya Nadella, Sarah Guo and Elad Gil from No Priors, and Swyx from Latent Space
briefings.tldr: AI value is shifting from raw foundation models to an ecosystem-driven "harness" layer where enterprises use private evaluations and custom agentic workflows to hill-climb performance.

briefings.title: No Priors Ep. 80 | With Andrej Karpathy from OpenAI and Tesla
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: Andrej Karpathy discusses the parallels between self-driving car development and AGI, Tesla's transition to end-to-end neural networks for cars and humanoid robots, and his new venture Eureka Labs, which aims to scale expert teaching using AI-driven front-ends.
